name: document_apply
title: Apply AI document mutation
description: Apply a typed operation batch that the focused tools cannot represent, or with dry_run check it and get the normalized operations without changing anything. To change words, links or marks, document_text_replace and document_text_format are simpler and need no read. Up to 100 operations apply atomically in one call. Pass document_revision (and target_revision for a translation) from your latest document_read or the previous edit; no reread is needed between consecutive edits. Page rich blocks require a rich-text section parent. A table needs insert_block plus set_field table (shared UUID rows/cells, id equal to handle, header flags) and set_field tableContent (locale cell content). Pages forbid inline math. See document_catalog. On sync_required nothing changed: run the returned document_read recipe (it rereads the blocks the edit targeted), compare the latest values with the intended edit, and retry with the new revisions.

name: file_transfer
title: Transfer a File
description: Begin, inspect, complete or abort one File ingest through the existing File authority. To upload a local file: begin with transport=presigned_multipart returns upload.part_uploads; PUT each part's exact bytes to its URL, for example with curl -T, then call complete with session. Nothing else is needed: the bytes are verified at completion. URLs expire in minutes and a large File gets at most 32 at a time; parts takes session and returns URLs for the parts still missing. abort takes session and discards an unfinished session. Field sets per action: begin multipart (transport=browser_upload_page or presigned_multipart) takes kind, transport, file_name, mime_type, file_size and optional last_modified_ms; begin remote_https takes kind, transport, remote_url and correlation_id; status, parts and abort take session; complete takes session and optional client_media_bundle_id. Other fields are rejected. transport=browser_upload_page leaves the bytes to the authenticated browser upload flow. Direct audio/video requires browser-prepared derivatives and gets no upload URLs; complete must pass the client_media_bundle_id returned by status after browser preparation. For a public HTTPS source, remote_https uses the existing server import and processing flow; all kinds except general require a stable correlation_id reused on retry. track_audio requires track_id and attaches through native Track authority/CAS. Omit expected_current_file_id only when the Track has no original audio; otherwise copy its current File UUID. Pass the returned session unchanged, including its Track/CAS fields.

action.description: begin starts one File transfer (requires kind and transport); status inspects, parts re-issues upload URLs for missing parts, complete finishes and abort discards a multipart session (all require session). Send only the fields listed for the chosen action/transport.

kind.description: begin only, required. File ingest kind. track_audio attaches original audio through existing Track authority and CAS; audio remains an independent editor File.

transport.description: begin only, required. presigned_multipart: returns URLs you PUT the bytes to yourself. browser_upload_page: the authenticated browser upload flow sends the bytes. remote_https: server import from a public HTTPS URL.

mime_type.description: begin multipart: required; forbidden for remote_https. Original MIME type; must match the filename and verified bytes.

file_size.description: begin multipart: required; forbidden for remote_https. Original File size in bytes.

last_modified_ms.description: begin multipart: optional; forbidden for remote_https. Original last-modified time in Unix epoch milliseconds, used for upload resumption.

remote_url.description: begin remote_https: required; forbidden for multipart. Public HTTPS source URL without credentials or a fragment. Server import verifies bytes and uses existing media processing.

expected_target_revision.description: Exact target_revision returned by translation_xliff_export. Required for an existing target; omit only to create a currently absent target. A concurrent change causes a conflict.

unit_ids.description: Opaque unit IDs affected by the validated import.

name: work_create
title: Create Work
description: Create a new draft Work with an empty typed document in the requested source locale. Set is_present true for an ongoing Work, or supply both until_year and until_month.

until_year.description: Required with until_month unless is_present is true; must be omitted when is_present is true.

until_month.description: Required with until_year unless is_present is true; must be omitted when is_present is true.

is_present.description: When true, until_year and until_month must be omitted. Otherwise both fields are required.

access_policy.description: Who can read the Page. public: every visitor; authenticated: signed-in members; conditions: members matching allowed_roles, user_tag_ids, or newsletter_subscriber, combined by match. Administrators who manage the Page can always read it.

match.description: conditions only. any accepts one selected condition group; all requires every selected group. Default any.

allowed_roles.description: conditions only. Signed-in members without these roles use authenticated mode or user_tag_ids instead.

user_tag_ids.description: conditions only. Member tag IDs from reference_search with reference_type=member_tag.

name: work_credit_add
title: Add Work credit
description: Add an artist, Member, or literal-name credit to a Work, optionally inside a credit group. Supply exactly one of artist_id, member_id, or name.

document_id.description: Canonical document UUID returned by document_list or another authenticated document surface; never a slug or URL.

artist_id.description: Artist UUID from reference_search with reference_type=artist. Supply exactly one of artist_id, member_id, or name.

member_id.description: Member UUID from member_admin_list or reference_search with reference_type=member. Supply exactly one of artist_id, member_id, or name.

name.description: Literal credit name. Supply exactly one of artist_id, member_id, or name.

name: work_credit_delete
title: Delete Work credit
description: Delete one Work credit.

name: work_credit_group_create
title: Create Work credit group
description: Create a named credit group on a Work.

document_id.description: Canonical document UUID returned by document_list or another authenticated document surface; never a slug or URL.

name: work_credit_group_delete
title: Delete Work credit group
description: Delete a Work credit group using the existing Work credit rules.

name: work_credit_group_update
title: Update Work credit group
description: Rename a Work credit group and return its current fields.

name: work_credit_update
title: Update Work credit
description: Move a Work credit between groups or change its role and return its current fields. Supply group_id, credit_role, or both.

group_id.description: Credit group UUID from work_credits_get, or an empty string to remove the group relation. Supply group_id, credit_role, or both.

credit_role.description: New credit role. Supply group_id, credit_role, or both.

name: work_credits_get
title: Get Work credits
description: Read all credit groups and credits attached to a Work.

document_id.description: Canonical document UUID returned by document_list or another authenticated document surface; never a slug or URL.

name: work_settings_update
title: Update Work settings
description: Update Work slug, type, metadata, featured flag, clients, period, or Map Place relation. Read document_settings_get before editing metadata or client_ids and supply its unchanged values as observed_metadata or observed_client_ids; concurrent peer edits are merged using that observed baseline. Use document_metadata_update for title or summary.

document_id.description: Canonical document UUID returned by document_list or another authenticated document surface; never a slug or URL.

slug.description: New slug, or an empty string to remove the slug.

metadata.description: Requires observed_metadata in the same call.

observed_metadata.description: Required when metadata is supplied. Copy metadata returned by document_settings_get before editing. Preserve unchanged fields to keep concurrent peer edits.

client_ids.description: Client IDs from reference_search with reference_type=client. Requires observed_client_ids in the same call.

observed_client_ids.description: Required when client_ids is supplied. Copy client_ids returned by document_settings_get before editing, including an empty array when no clients were present.

map_place_id.description: Map Place UUID from map_place_list or reference_search with reference_type=map_place, or an empty string to remove the relation.

is_present.description: Setting true clears the stored until date. Setting false for a currently present Work requires until_year and until_month in the same call.
